description: This script implements a Perl version of the 'xxd -i' utility, converting binary data into a C-style byte array initialization. It can read input from a specified file or standard input, and outputs a C array declaration with data bytes and length variable, with options to customize the variable name and output format.

methods.name: main logic
methods.description: Contains the main script logic for reading input, processing data, and outputting the C array. No specific sub-methods are defined.
